name: B23M-C
summary: B23M-C is a Leadshine integrated optical encoder family using a spring connection to accommodate motor shaft movement. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

sources.quote: B23M-C系列光编码器有以下特点： 1、重复定位精度＜±3角秒； 2、弹片连接，克服电机窜动； 3、双向异步串行通信，单圈23位，多圈16位； 4、严苛EMC测试，满足恶劣电磁环境工况； 产品优势
